grades.quote: Only when the `LLbit` is `1` , the write action will actually occur, otherwise it will not be written.
grades.reason: This is the LoongArch LL/SC description. It explains the LLbit mechanism: SC writes only if LLbit is 1. It lists the events that clear LLbit (ERTN without KL0=1, a store by another core or I/O master to the same cache line). It also says SC writes a success flag (the LLbit value it saw) into rd so the software retry loop can work.
This passage is about the RISC-V operational memory model (early sc fail). The query requires LoongArch, so it is the wrong ISA.
